gates.name: dotnet test SubZeroDev.Platform.slnx --configuration Release --no-build
gates.detail:
Failed!  - Failed: 1, Passed: 264, Skipped: 0, Total: 265 - SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests.dll (net10.0). Passed! - Failed: 0, Passed: 19, Total: 19 - SubZeroDev.Platform.GameEdge.Tests.dll (net10.0).

The one failure is WorkerProbeTests.The_worker_serves_its_probes_on_loopback_and_nowhere_else:
  System.Net.Sockets.SocketException : nodename nor servname provided, or not known
     at System.Net.Dns.GetHostEntryOrAddressesCore(String hostName, Boolean justAddresses, AddressFamily addressFamily, Nullable`1 activityOrDefault)
     at System.Net.Dns.GetHostAddresses(String hostNameOrAddress, AddressFamily family)
     at SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests.WorkerProbeTests.BoundOnAnyNonLoopbackAddress(Int32 port) in tests/SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests/WorkerProbeTests.cs:line 100
     at SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests.WorkerProbeTests.The_worker_serves_its_probes_on_loopback_and_nowhere_else() in tests/SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests/WorkerProbeTests.cs:line 88

The test resolves this machine's own hostname to find a non-loopback address to probe against; DNS resolution of the host name fails on this Mac. This pull request changes three Markdown files under design/ and no C#, so the failure is not attributable to the diff — but it ran, it failed, and it is reported as failed rather than explained away. CI is where the same test's real answer comes from.
